_comment: DRAFT pricing — placeholder numbers for Daniel to review/adjust before go-live. Availability status per category is grounded in the Artifact Factory's library_snapshot.json QA lane counts as of 2026-08-30 (by_lane clean/total): Registers 18/18, ITPs 80/131, SWMS 9/211, Forms 10/123, Plans 20/198, Audit 2/17. Only Registers and ITPs have enough QA-clean inventory to sell as instant-download bundles today. SWMS entries exist here to show the intended catalog breadth (matches the 21 trade series on siteguardsystems.com.au) but stay 'coming-soon' until each trade clears review — do not flip any SWMS item to self-serve without checking current clean counts for that specific trade first.
